name: matiq
description: MatIQ: AI Martial Arts Analyzer & Social Hub (monorepo)

scripts.functions:check: npm run sync:shared && deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/*/index.ts
scripts.functions:test: npm run sync:shared && deno test --config supabase/functions/deno.json --allow-env supabase/functions/
scripts.functions:serve: npm run sync:shared && supabase functions serve --env-file supabase/functions/.env
scripts.functions:deploy: npm run sync:shared && supabase functions deploy
